strings.subtitle: — Burburiyaha faylalka —
strings.dnd_unavailable: Jiidista iyo dhigista lama heli karo. Isticmaal badhanka hoose.
strings.shred_button: B U R B U R I
strings.ssd_warning:
Digniin! SSD-yada, habka dib-u-qoris ma dammaanad qaadanayo burburinta sababo la xiriira TRIM.
Barnaamijkani waa HDD.
strings.confirm_text:
Faylka "{name}" waa la dib-u-qori doonaa oo la tirtiri doonaa.

Sii wad?
strings.confirm_lnk_text:
This is a shortcut (.lnk). Only the shortcut itself will be destroyed.

The target file it points to will remain intact.

Continue?
strings.drive_remote_warning:
This is a network drive (\\server\share).
Sector overwrite does not guarantee destruction — the server may have snapshots, deduplication or CoW.

Continue?
strings.drive_removable_warning:
This is a removable drive (USB stick / external HDD).
The controller may keep old blocks in reserve.

Continue?
strings.report_title: ✅  FAYLKA WAA LA DIB-U-QORAY OO LA TIRTIRAY
strings.report_limits:
• Qulqulka xogta beddelka NTFS (ADS) lama shaqeeyo.
• Joornaalka USN lama nadiifiyo.
• Nuqullada hooska iyo isku-xirka daruuraha
  (OneDrive iwm.) lama saameeyaan.
strings.status_full: Nuxurka si buuxda ayaa loogu qoray eber. Soo-celinta lama suurtagelin — qalabku wuxuu arki doonaa oo keliya eber.
strings.status_fast: Madaxa, dabada iyo xariijimaha 4 MB waa la dib-u-qoray. Inta kale lama taaban, laakiin sababo la xiriira nusqaamaha, soo-celinta buuxda ee qalabka macaamiisha waa lama suurtagelin. Dukumentiyada qarsoodiga ah isticmaal qaybta BUUXA.
strings.status_empty: Faylku madhan yahay, dib-u-qoris lama baahna. La tirtiray.
strings.error_permission: Lama gaari karo faylka. Waxaa laga yaabaa inuu ku furan yahay barnaamij kale. Xir oo isku day mar kale.
strings.error_not_found: Faylka lama helin. Waxaa laga yaabaa in horay loo tirtiray.
strings.error_is_symlink: Kani waa isku-xir calaamadeed. Isku-xirrada lama burburin karo — faylka bartilmaameedka wuxuu ahaan doonaa mid caafimaad qaba.
strings.error_reparse: Kani waa fayl boos-bane (OneDrive ama la mid ah). Xogtuna waxay ku jirtaa daruurta, ma aha diskiga — halkan waxba lama burburin karo.
strings.error_not_file: Kani ma aha fayl (folder ama wax kale). Dhig fayl.
strings.error_hardlinks: Faylkani wuxuu leeyahay isku-xir adag oo kale ({n} wadar). Isku-xirrada adag ma laha mid koowaad — dhammaan magacyadu waa siman yihiin. Haddii aad ku burburiso jidka hadda, xogta waa la dib-u-qori doonaa oo la gooyn doonaa 32 byte, laakiin hadhaagu wuxuu ku sii jiri doonaa isku-xirrada kale. Marka hore tirtir dhammaan isku-xirrada.
strings.error_compressed:
Faylka waa la isku-duubay, la sireeyay ama khafiif. Dib-u-qoris eber ma dammaanad qaadanayo burburinta xogta hore sababtoo ah NTFS si kala duwan ayay u kaydisaa.

Ka saar sifada: midig ku riix → Sifooyin → Sare → ka saar calaamada "Isku-duub" iyo/ama "Siree". Kadib mar kale socodsii SHREDDER.
